note: Maybank's fees and charges for current accounts: a half-yearly service fee of 10 ringgit on an individual account whose average balance in the half year is under 1,000 ringgit (new accounts opened in June or December excepted, not modelled).

sources.title: Maybank, Fees and Charges: Current Account
sources.said: Half yearly service fee: a. All accounts with an average balance of less than RM1,000 for Individual/Joint Accounts & RM1,000 for Business Accounts each half year in June/December except for new accounts opened in June or December RM10
